items.title: FREE forever + accuracy-over-speed + our own pipeline running CONSTANTLY
items.note: Your directive 2026-08-16: keep it free (no paid services ever), don't care about speed/timing — care about ACCURACY, and build our own web-scraping data-gathering pipeline that runs constantly (a warm, always-fresh, self-healing store, not on-demand fetches). Sequencing: Phase 6.9 (in plan-check) stays as the provider FOUNDATION (cascade/cross-check/degrade/store) — all already free. Layering on top: (a) MORE free sources folded into the registry, (b) a new phase for the always-on scheduled daemon. Launched ecosystem research: how people pull free data without paying (OpenBB, undocumented public JSON APIs, SEC XBRL for free fundamentals/float — our weak spot, Wayback backfill), anti-block+accuracy triangulation (Stooq IP-block is a live test case), and the constantly-running self-healing pipeline architecture. Accuracy lever = aggressive multi-source triangulation + slow polite polling, NOT spend.

items.title: The free-data layer was RESEARCHED but never BUILT — Phase 6.9 closes it before any real backtest
items.note: Discrepancy I found on your 'take a step back, examine the discrepancy' order: free-data-sources.md specced CBOE/yfinance/FINRA/EDGAR/FedRegister/RTTNews (all verified-live) but only 2 providers were ever built; everything downstream ran on mocks. Phase 6.9 builds the real providers + scrapers with discipline (rate-limit, ≥5-min cache, provenance-on-every-datum, never-fabricate), wires them to the seams with ZERO downstream contract change, and its verification IS the live shakedown: ingest the real 21-name universe → run Layer-A backtest + thesis_scan on REAL data → log every edge case. This is the real-data stress test of every system + the first real backtest number. FMP is 401 on historicals (confirmed) → yfinance is primary for prices.

items.title: Prices are a MULTI-SOURCE cascade, NOT yfinance-only (your correction)
items.note: Your correction 2026-08-15: 'we shouldn't be defaulting to yfinance, there should be a plethora of sources and systems.' Right call — the research gave every OTHER need ≥2 sources (short interest is triple-verified FINRA/Nasdaq/yfinance) but collapsed the most load-bearing datum, price history, to yfinance-only. Fix: providers/prices.py runs a RANKED cascade (Stooq CSV → yfinance → Nasdaq historical → keyed Alpha Vantage/Tiingo — order pending live verification), falls through on failure/missing name, cross-checks closes where ≥2 sources agree (flags divergence), tags each bar with its source. Generalizes to a source-registry so adding sources later is trivial (modular/future-facing per your standing mandate). Stopped the planner + launched a focused price-cascade research pass to verify endpoints live before re-planning (no ad-hoc guessing).

items.title: All price sources deliver RAW (auto_adjust=False), not back-adjusted
items.note: Money-critical call I made autonomously: adjusted prices back-adjust the whole series to TODAY's split/dividend state — a silent look-ahead in a point-in-time backtest (the exact thing the pessimistic gap-fill + latency knob + as_of guards fight). Raw OHLC is what actually printed each week. Splits in this 21-name universe over 1-2yr are rare + detectable → flagged as shakedown edge cases, not silently smoothed over. Confirm you're OK with raw + split-week flagging vs adjusted.

items.title: Key finding: the STORE is the seam — 'zero downstream contract change' is nearly free
items.note: Research verified nothing downstream (thesis_scan/run_layer_a/build_event_set/run_scan) fetches anything — all read the store or an injected raw dict. So live ingestion just writes the SAME rows via the SAME upsert_bars/insert_catalyst/write_card. No live=True/False boolean threads through the desk; the toggle is only WHO populates the store. Shrinks the phase to thin plumbing over already-built machinery.

items.title: The 'catch the bounce' edge is REAL but thin (~+1%) and only at moderate drops
items.note: Measured on our own 18-biotech data: -5/-10% drops bounce ~54-55% vs 51.3% base (~+1% edge). BUT -15% weeks = falling knife (48.8%, negative median) — a hard veto, not a bounce. Up-week continuation is a coin flip unconditionally. Savor 2012: info-moves drift, no-info moves reverse — so the drop-classifier is what makes it honest. Expect only 2-4 tradeable trigger cells to survive. This is the honest ceiling on the mean-reversion thesis.

items.title: No-zero-trade-weeks reconciled: weak weeks get a DEFENSIVE book, not a forced bad trade
items.note: When no trigger cell clears the bar, the week is SGOV/BIL + tiny XBI anchors with dossier language saying exactly that — never a forced failing trade. This is how 'always a portfolio' stays honest with survival-first. Confirm you're OK with defensive/cash-like weeks counting as a valid book.
